label: KakaoTalk Channel
terms_note: Kakao Developers app (business app + Kakao Sync approval for messaging); the Kakao Talk Channel API only adds a channel / checks the relationship / registers customer files; channel broadcast and marketing messages go through the Channel Manager Center or official dealers (paid); the Kakao Talk Message API (talk/memo/default/send, talk/friends/message/default/send) reaches only friends who also use the app, with daily quotas.

capabilities: inbox_dm(Kakao Talk Message API to app friends only)
sdks: Kakao SDK (JS / Android / iOS) for followChannel / addChannel

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** (channel add / relationship + friend messaging only; no channel posts). Lane
auth: 1. Kakao Developers app; Kakao Login (OAuth 2.0) for user-context calls; **business app** conversion + Kakao Sync
2. A Kakao Talk Channel is linked to the app in the console (channel public id).
reference.limits: - Message API daily quotas per user; Kakao Sync + business verification; Korean IT Network Act consent rules for marketing messages; dealer contract for 알림톡 / 친구톡.

reason: Re-checked 2026-09-25 in headless Chromium: the Kakao Talk Channel API (https://developers.kakao.com/docs/en/kakaotalk-channel/common#api-list) only adds a channel / opens a chat through the Kakao SDK, checks the user's channel relationship, and uploads customer files (kapi.kakao.com/v1/talkchannel/create/target_user_file, update/target_users, delete/target_users) for friend groups; channel messages are sent in the Kakao Talk Channel Manager Center, and the remaining 'message' docs are Kakao Talk user-to-user messaging and Kakao Moment ad creatives. No endpoint posts to a channel, reads comments or mentions, or deletes a post.
